<#macro cleanSpecialChars input>
        <#assign cleaned = input

        ?replace("(?i)≤", "≤", "r")
        ?replace("(?i)≥", "≥", "r")
        ?replace("(?i)&", "&", "r")
        ?replace("(?i)"", "\"", "r")
        ?replace("(?i)'", "'", "r")
        ?replace("(?i) ", " ", "r")>

    </#macro>
